name: Ollama
advantage: Lightweight background daemon, instant model pulls, OpenAI-compatible API
downside: CLI-first, needs separate WebUI for chat

name: LM Studio
advantage: Polished desktop GUI with built-in Hugging Face downloader and hardware monitoring
downside: Closed-source, heavier memory footprint

name: llama.cpp
runsOn: Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, Raspberry Pi
advantage: Extreme optimization, GGUF quantization standard, minimal overhead
downside: Steep technical learning curve, compilation required for best performance

name: vLLM
advantage: PagedAttention algorithm, blazing fast token throughput for multi-agent setups
downside: Requires dedicated high-VRAM GPU setup, heavy for small micro PCs

name: Jan
advantage: 100% open-source local chat interface with clean modular extension support
downside: Fewer power-user model quantization tuning knobs

name: LocalAI
advantage: Handles LLM, audio generation, TTS, and embeddings in one unified binary/container
downside: Complex configuration across multiple backends

name: Aphrodite Engine
advantage: Built specifically for creative writing/character companions with fast sampling algorithms
downside: Linux-focused, requires discrete GPU

name: faster-whisper
advantage: Up to 4x faster than standard OpenAI Whisper with CTranslate2 optimization
downside: Still requires decent CPU/RAM for large-v3 models

name: Whisper.cpp
runsOn: Raspberry Pi, Linux, macOS, iOS, Android
advantage: Pure C/C++ with zero dependencies, runs smoothly on ARM and micro PCs
downside: Lacks real-time streaming VAD pipeline out of the box

name: Vosk
advantage: Ultra-lightweight (runs on 50MB RAM), near-zero latency for wake words
downside: Accuracy lower than Whisper on complex conversational speech

name: Whisper-Live
advantage: Real-time low-latency WebSocket client-server streaming transcription
downside: Requires tuned server setup to avoid audio buffer drift

name: Piper TTS
advantage: Fast, real-time speech generation even on low-spec Raspberry Pi 4/5 CPUs
downside: Voice cloning is complex compared to one-shot neural models

name: Kokoro TTS
advantage: Ultra-expressive 82M parameter model delivering near-commercial studio quality locally
downside: English/multilingual accents still expanding

name: XTTS v2
advantage: 3-second instant zero-shot voice cloning across 17+ languages
downside: High VRAM requirement (4GB+ GPU)

name: StyleTTS 2
advantage: Natural emotional prosody and breathing pauses indistinguishable from humans
downside: Complex dependencies and inference pipeline

name: Bark
advantage: Generates non-verbal sounds (laughter, sighs, clearing throat, music)
downside: Slower generation times, prone to audio hallucination

name: Letta (MemGPT)
advantage: Stateful memory architecture allowing deskbots to remember conversations forever
downside: Multi-tier memory calls increase prompt token overhead

name: ElizaOS
advantage: Multi-platform connectors (Discord, Twitter, Telegram, Voice) with rich character cards
downside: Fast-moving repo with frequent breaking API changes

name: AutoGen
advantage: Enables conversational collaboration between multiple specialized agents
downside: Can loop and burn compute if termination logic is ambiguous

name: LangChain
advantage: Massive ecosystem of connectors, hardware sensor tools, and vector DBs
downside: Can feel bloated with excessive abstractions

name: Raspberry Pi 5 (8GB)
advantage: Huge GPIO ecosystem, native camera/mic headers, active cooling ecosystem
downside: Too weak for 8B+ LLMs (best as edge audio/motor coordinator paired with a host)

name: Beelink SER8 (AMD Ryzen 7)
advantage: Powerful Radeon 780M iGPU with fast dual-channel DDR5 RAM for speedy 8B/14B models
downside: Unified memory capped by SODIMM speed compared to Mac unified bandwidth

name: Mac Mini (M4 / 24GB Unified)
advantage: 120GB/s unified memory bandwidth runs 14B–32B quantized models with whisper-quiet fan
downside: Zero internal hardware upgradability, proprietary ecosystem

name: ESP32-S3 Dev Board
advantage: Built-in Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 5, hardware vector acceleration for small wake-words
downside: Tiny 8MB PSRAM cannot run natural language LLMs directly

name: PCA9685 16-Channel Servo Driver
advantage: Drives up to 16 servos simultaneously over 2 I2C pins with external power rail
downside: Requires dedicated 5V/6V 3A+ power supply to prevent servo jitter
